definitions.crossing: Disjoint endpoint island memberships. May be legitimate HVDC/FC or attribution error; never automatically classified as an AC fault.
definitions.geometry_gap: Endpoint to first/last path point >500m, choosing the better orientation. Substation centroid attachments may be intentional.
definitions.self_loops: Coordinate loops include declared intra-substation stubs. They are not automatically errors or candidates for removal.
